changeSet.author: openk9
changeSet.comment: Rename duplicate sorting names, keeping the oldest, then add the unique constraint on name
changeSet.sql: WITH duplicate_names AS ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY name ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM sorting ) UPDATE sorting s SET name = LEFT(s.name, 255 - LENGTH(' - Copy ' || (dn.rn - 1))) || ' - Copy ' || (dn.rn - 1) FROM duplicate_names dn WHERE s.id = dn.id AND dn.rn > 1;
